description: Fetch and extract clean readable text from any URL. Full JS rendering via Playwright — works on SPAs and dynamic sites. Returns title, text (cleaned content, default max 8000 chars), description, word_count, and optional links array. Ideal for web research, content summarization, or feeding page content to an LLM. Price: $0.006 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"url":"https://example.com","max_chars":4000}.

include_links.description: If true, include up to 50 links found on the page

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of text to return (truncated with …)

url.description: The URL to read and extract content from

name: webpage_reader
title: Webpage Reader
